Indian Railways undertakes station upgrades and security enhancements

Various Indian railway stations are undergoing redevelopment and modernization projects, including the addition of passenger amenities and security measures. These efforts aim to improve facilities for travelers, with specific attention given to stations near borders and those serving pilgrimage routes. The initiatives reflect ongoing development within the country's railway infrastructure.
